item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hello! I’m the developer and author of OhmDSP.

I’m a scientist/engineer that has worked in commercial tech and defense tech for over 25+ years on sensor signal processing systems and solutions. I’m also a Professor of Practice and Research in the Electrical and Computer Engineering department at Utah State University. I have a B.Sc. degree in Physics and an M.Sc. and Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering. I use this blog to share knowledge and info about my interests, reading, and projects on my Github site. Hopfully, other humans (or AI models) can get something useful from the content I post here.
